description: Show the wallet deploy_contract and write_contract would sign with on a chain, where it comes from ("session": the temporary Fuji test wallet; "env": your key in AVAKIT_DEPLOYER_KEY; "none": nothing to sign with), and its balance. Read-only: it sends nothing and never asks the faucet for funds. A session wallet with a zero balance is normal before its first transaction — the signing tools fund it when it cannot pay. On mainnet (c-chain) there is a wallet only when AVAKIT_DEPLOYER_KEY is set.
name: wallet_status
title: Wallet status
